senses.gloss: cuccu-kārakam, adv., making the sound cuccu (smacking the lips ? sc. while eating): Mvy 〔8577〕 na cu˚; completed by piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti, LaVallée Poussin, JRAS 〔1913.845〕, Stein ms. fragm. 〔1.2.12〕. May correspond to Pali capucapu-kārakaṃ, Vin. 〔iv.197.13〕. Chin. onomat., indicating that one has eaten something sour.
